headline: Argentine Software Industry Employment Stagnates Amid Rising Dollar Salaries
summary: Employment growth in Argentina's software industry has stalled while dollar-denominated salaries reached two-year highs, compressing profit margins as international client billing rates face ceilings.
why: Software exports are a vital source of foreign exchange and skilled employment in Argentina's technology ecosystem.
